title: PR #225 hosted program-content RLS verification manifest

setup.scope: Nine-table authorization boundary, production-catalog-derived policies and helpers only

secretHandling: Values must be supplied via a protected environment/secret manager and are never copied to evidence. PGPASSFILE must be mode 0600 or stricter. The runner writes redacted evidence with mode 0600.
hostedScenarios: anonymous published program catalog metadata remains visible
anonymous direct module and content-item reads denied
Auth Admin creates synthetic users; password sign-in obtains Auth-issued sessions
real PostgREST bearer-token requests for active entitlement, active assignment, missing, expired, future, wrong-program, and revoked access
member retains own historical enrollment and published-version metadata after access loss
authenticated admin role reads, grants, and revokes a program entitlement
server-side privileged supabase-js PostgREST authoring CRUD succeeds
EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS on policy-protected helper/module/item/delivery queries with synthetic decoy volumes
offlineFailurePathTests: protected refs and absent direct Management API credential fail before network/database access
healthy and unhealthy branch identity handling
empty/mismatched cleanup refs rejected before delete
branch deletion absence confirmation and timeout
multiline EXPLAIN JSON with preceding psql output
write-attempt evidence set before a failed fixture application
knownLimitations: This targeted fixture is not a complete Production schema replica and does not replay historical migrations.
The local PostgreSQL fixture uses test-only simulated Auth role/JWT functions; it does not establish hosted Auth or PostgREST behavior.
Performance results from the synthetic data volume are not Production latency/SLO evidence.
One temporary branch is explicitly approved at $0.01344/hour plus applicable usage but has not been provisioned because direct runner credentials and a protected passfile are missing.
